title: 5 Bluechip Stocks at 52 Week High - Should You Chase? - Rahul Jain
creator: Rahul Jain
source_note: Detailed summary generated from the video's English auto-captions; five blue chips near 52-week highs with balanced positives and risks, no explicit recommendation on any stock.
summary: Nifty has reclaimed and held 25,000, and an Economic Times article flagged 12 blue chips near 52-week highs; Rahul Jain picks five for unbiased commentary, stressing a 52-week high signals momentum, not a guarantee. ICICI Bank's Q2 FY27 was strong - profit up ~20%, net interest income up ~18%, deposits up 27% - but the deposit jump is largely a one-off from RBI's FCNR scheme (17% without it), and net interest margin fell to 4.18% from 4.30% with more compression guided; P/B ~2.9x vs a 3.0x five-year median is some comfort. Dr Reddy's is the puzzle: near a 52-week high while profit fell ~36% after losing Revlimid's US exclusivity in January 2026, with margins recovering and two triggers ahead - a November 2026 semaglutide launch and an abatacept biosimilar approval - though ROCE is only 9.5% and the ~40x P/E is distorted by collapsed earnings. Bharti Airtel grew profit 31% and revenue 17% on premiumisation (ARPU Rs 271 versus Jio's Rs 218) and deleveraged to 0.7x net debt/EBITDA, but its subscriber base is flat and data remains unmonetised. Eternal (Zomato) shows headline profit up 92%, yet ex-other-income operating profit is still negative, and Blinkit's EBITDA is just 0.9% of net order value against a 6% steady-state guide. L&T's profit rose 33% on a record order book up 28%, but most of the profit growth came from other income and margins compressed on aggressive bidding. He flags MSTC, a small PSU monopoly up 20% on an upper circuit, as a possible future video, and stresses none of this is a recommendation.
